original_title: Latest Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer teases the return of The Hulk
summary_en: The latest trailer for **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** offers a glimpse into Peter Parker's new reality, where a world-altering spell has made him a stranger to his loved ones. Now, a new threat emerges, and it seems even Earth's mightiest heroes might not be on his side.
ai_analysis: This trailer deepens the emotional stakes for Peter Parker, suggesting a pivotal arc where his isolation forces him to confront familiar allies turned adversaries, raising questions about the future of the Avengers' dynamic.

en.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Trailer Hints At Hulk's Rage
en.summary: The latest trailer for **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** offers a glimpse into Peter Parker's new reality, where a world-altering spell has made him a stranger to his loved ones. Now, a new threat emerges, and it seems even Earth's mightiest heroes might not be on his side.
en.body:
The web-slinging hero is back, but in **Spider-Man: Brand New Day**, the world has forgotten him. The latest trailer pulls back the curtain on Peter Parker's (Tom Holland) post-spell existence, where his closest friends, including MJ (Zendaya) and Ned (Jacob Batalon), have no memory of him. This profound isolation, a consequence of Doctor Strange's (Benedict Cumberbatch) spell intended to protect him, sets the stage for a deeply personal struggle as Peter must re-establish his connections while facing escalating threats.

The trailer doesn't just recap Peter's journey through **Homecoming**, **Far From Home**, and **No Way Home**; it emphasizes the significance of these bonds and the personal cost of their erasure. Five years into this new reality, the pressure is mounting. As new villains loom, Peter finds himself in an unexpected confrontation: with the Hulk. Footage shows the Jade Giant, seemingly in a fit of rage, smashing Spider-Man into a skyscraper, a stark visual that hints at a brutal, uncharacteristic conflict between two of Marvel's most prominent heroes.

## The Hulk's Unexpected Fury

This isn't the first time **Mark Ruffalo**'s Hulk has been teased in relation to **Spider-Man: Brand New Day**. Previous glimpses have shown a powerful clash, with some suggesting a dual nature to the confrontation, potentially involving both Smart Hulk and a more primal, enraged version of the character. The trailer specifically highlights this rage, leaving fans to speculate on the cause. Is the Hulk being manipulated, or is this a genuine breakdown of the hero's control? The implications for the wider MCU are significant, especially if a foundational Avenger like the Hulk is acting so erratically.

> "The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn't forgotten them." — Official Synopsis

This line underscores Peter's enduring commitment to protecting those he cares about, even in the face of personal oblivion. The question remains: why would the Hulk turn on Spider-Man? The trailer offers no easy answers, only the spectacle of an Avenger seemingly attacking another hero, adding a layer of tragic irony to Peter's already challenging circumstances.

## Fan Frenzy and Speculation

Fans are understandably losing their minds over the Hulk's brutal appearance. The sight of the Hulk smashing Spider-Man has ignited a firestorm of theories across social media. Many are focusing on the narrative potential of this conflict, wondering if it's a sign of the Hulk's evolving character arc or a deliberate plot point to isolate Peter further. The trailer's emphasis on Peter fighting a furious Hulk, and the tease of Scorpion's return, suggests **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** will deliver high-octane action alongside its emotional core. The community is buzzing with anticipation, eager to see how Peter navigates this dangerous new world and if he can mend fractured alliances.

## What's Next

**Spider-Man: Brand New Day** is set to swing into theaters on July 31, 2026. Tickets are on sale now, and with the trailer dropping, anticipation is building for what promises to be a pivotal chapter in Tom Holland's Spider-Man saga.

content_raw: There will be web-slinging, gravity-defying antics, and heroics aplenty in the latest Spider-Man entry in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. In the latest trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day , audiences get a bit of a reminder of what’s happened to the scrappy boy hero from Queens. Dr. Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch) casts a spell that causes the world to forget the real identity of Spider-Man, Peter Parker (Tom Holland). That includes Parker’s friends and loved ones, like MJ (Zendaya). But now, with new villains on the way, Spider-Man is back in action and must properly reintroduce himself to those he cares about.  This latest trailer includes footage from the previous Spider-Man movies starring Tom Holland, Homecoming ,   Far From Home , and  No Way Home , recapping how much time has passed since we started following this version of Peter Parker on his many adventures and emphasizing how much these friendships mean to Parker. Five years later, Parker must once again save New York and MJ, with what looks like little help from Bruce Banner/The Hulk (Mark Ruffalo), who instead takes to fighting his fellow Avenger. We’ll know why the Hulk smashes our hero into a skyscraper when Spider-Man: Brand New Day  swings into theaters July 31.
